_template_note: PLACEHOLDER FILE. Replace all token_mint values with real operator-approved Solana token mint addresses before use. Do not pass this file to the preflight command until all placeholder values are replaced and approved_by_operator is true.

_rules.token_count: 1 or 2 tokens only. First bounded E2C cycle cap is 2.
_rules.token_mint_format: Solana base58 address, 43-44 characters, base58 alphabet only (no 0, O, I, l).
_rules.no_invented_addresses: Printer does not generate or recommend token addresses. Operator must supply real addresses independently.
_rules.no_financial_advice: This is a paper-trading tracking input only. No recommendation or investment framing.
